labels.reason: The body reports group-summary total-radioactivity recovery as percentages of dose in urine, cagewash, cage debris, feces and combined excretion through 120 h. DR003 and DR004 have source-backed record-level and identity evidence, with unspecified fields retained as gaps. DR007 is supported by the printed count and dose, while MI003 and MI004 remain separate OPEN CONFLICT items; competing statements are not supplied on this page. DR012 and MC015 have partial supporting excretion evidence, but these measurements do not distinguish unchanged meropenem from metabolites and cannot establish unchanged urinary recovery or renal clearance. The recovery column combines several sample types, so its meaning is OTHER rather than an exclusively urinary amount. Repeated count and dose statements are preserved separately without reconciliation. These are candidate input classifications, not scientific qualification for translation.
